product_overview: Eventify is a responsive web application for discovering local events and signing in to access a personalized dashboard. This PRD covers the public frontend functionality implemented in the codebase: event discovery and user authentication.
core_goals: Discover and browse available events in the local area
Open and read event details to decide on attendance
Authenticate with credentials to access a personalized dashboard
Quickly move between Home, Discover, and Dashboard pages

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to authenticate with their email and password so they can access their dashboard and personalized features.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See dashboard (/dashboard)
Navigate to /login -> Submit login form with missing or invalid email -> See inline validation error -> Correct email -> Submit login form -> See dashboard (/dashboard)

features.name: Discover Events
features.description: Enable users to browse the list of public events and open event details to learn more about specific events.
user_flows: Navigate to /discover -> Browse list of events -> Open event details -> See event information
Navigate to / -> Navigate to /discover -> Browse list of events -> Open event details -> See event information
